title: Scaffold a declaration
description: How an author or an agent starts a service from an archetype.

title: Report what may be declared
description: How an agent learns every component, setting and slot it may write, before it writes.

title: Check a declaration
description: How an author or an agent learns whether a declaration is acceptable, with the project untouched either way.

title: Repair a refused declaration
description: How an agent corrects a declaration from the refusal alone, with no person reading the message.

title: Sweep the fleet for a digest
description: How a platform engineer names every service built from a component digest.

title: Publish a fix as a successor
description: How a platform engineer gets a component fix to consumers with no new compiler.

title: Report superseded pins while working
description: How a service author learns, from validate or plan, that a pin is superseded.

title: Withdraw a digest after naming its consumers
description: How a platform engineer stops a digest from being used, and names every affected service first.

title: Qualify a release at one commit
description: How a platform engineer qualifies a compiler release before anyone can install it.

title: Install and identify a compiler
description: How an operator installs a compiler whose identity and platform they can verify.

title: Apply and keep the record
description: How apply leaves a record of every input beside the generated code.

title: Check a record against its code
description: How a platform engineer learns whether a record describes the code beside it.

title: Take a fix by a pin bump and a new run
description: How a service author takes a component fix as a diff a reviewer can read.

title: Change the declaration and run apply
description: How a changed declaration becomes changed code in one run.

title: Plan, review, apply
description: How a service author previews a run and then applies exactly what they saw.

title: Recover after an interruption
description: How a service author brings the files and the record back into agreement after apply stops part way.

title: Write a component
description: How a platform engineer adds a part that every service can build from.

title: Compose a registry for a team
description: How a platform engineer lets a team add its own parts without weakening the common ones.

title: Curate an archetype
description: How a platform engineer makes a golden path that a service author can select and trust.

title: Introduce an experimental component
description: How a team runs ahead of the platform team, visibly and for a stated time, without reaching a golden path.

title: Graduate or retire a component
description: How an experiment becomes a part everyone can rely on, or goes, with nobody surprised either way.
